Health doesn’t fail people at the moment of crisis. It fails them in the silent days before it. Arogyasetu fuses web-based self-report, real-time environmental exposure, and a trust-scored mutual-aid network into one closed predictive loop — delivering micro-interventions and discreet Care Pings before crisis.

                   

A privacy-first Predictive Community Health Operating System. Arogyasetu turns any desktop browser into a personal and community health safety net. It detects rising vulnerability windows from your own signals and your environment, then automatically delivers AI micro-interventions and discreet Care Pings to matched neighbors, peers, and volunteers — before crisis, never after.
